name: meta-questions
title_zh: 12 个元问题盘出你的 AI 杠杆点
tagline_zh: 不知道自己有什么可盘？它不问你简历，专挖优势、资源、关系网里你自己没当回事的暗资产。
tagline_en: Don't know what you're working with? It skips your resume and digs out the hidden assets in your strengths.
desc_en: 用 12 个元问题摸清用户的优势、资源与关系网，产出一份 AI Native 方向分析报告。触发词：元问题 / meta questions / 帮我盘一下我有什么 / 我该怎么用 AI / AI Native 诊断。
why_zh: 不是泛泛的职业测评。它用递进式元问题逼你从具体经历里提取可迁移模式。
why_en: Not another vague career quiz. It uses layered meta-questions to force you to extract transferable patterns from real.
limit_zh: 只产出方向报告，不含执行步骤或工具清单。需要你至少能答上 6 个问题，且问题偏认知盘查。
limit_en: Outputs a direction report only—no execution steps or tool lists. Requires you to answer at least 6 of 12 questions. Geared toward cognitive.
title_en: 12 meta questions to find your AI leverage
